description: Read cooldown time, progress, and readiness for an ability.
examples: Connect Flow, provide the cooldown key and scope, then branch on Ready or Cooldown.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the cooldown query.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: Identifies the cooldown to read.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Chooses which owner shares the cooldown.

inputs.name: content_id
inputs.description: Provides the content ID when the scope is content.

outputs.name: ready
outputs.description: Continues when the cooldown is ready.

outputs.name: cooldown
outputs.description: Continues while the cooldown is active.

outputs.name: ticks
outputs.description: Returns the remaining cooldown in server ticks.

outputs.name: seconds
outputs.description: Returns the remaining cooldown in seconds.

outputs.name: duration_ticks
outputs.description: Returns the configured cooldown duration in ticks.

outputs.name: elapsed_ticks
outputs.description: Returns the elapsed cooldown time in ticks.

outputs.name: progress
outputs.description: Returns normalized cooldown progress from zero to one.

outputs.name: progress_percent
outputs.description: Returns cooldown progress as a percentage.

outputs.name: started_at
outputs.description: Returns the cooldown start timestamp.

outputs.name: ready_at
outputs.description: Returns the timestamp when the cooldown is ready.

outputs.name: is_ready
outputs.description: Reports whether the cooldown is ready.
